column1: # The model and host species protal makes an extra effort for (since 2026-11-05; model_species.py, docs/databases.md).

# download may hold already: download_ref_data.py's host genome is GCF_009914755.1). genome_bases: NCBI's
# assembly_stats total-length of the GenBank assembly. rdna_unit: a curated GenBank rDNA unit (model_rdna_units.fna.gz)
# whose rRNA is the species' operon where its assembly gives none ("-": none curated). Eukaryotes get the euk30 loci
# their euk30 copies lack, placed in the assembly by miniprot whatever its size; prokaryotes are checked, not placed.
